title: Monitoring and reports
description: Collect new source publications and receive scheduled reports in Telegram.
firstRun: Create a project, add sources and choose one schedule. Collection runs in the background.
name: Project name
include: Include phrases (one per line, match any)
author: Telegram author ID (optional)
authorHint: Numeric Telegram user ID; usernames are not accepted. Other platforms are unaffected.
planLimits: Current plan: up to {sources} sources, collection at least every {interval} minutes, reports retained {days} days.
sourceUnavailableHint: Source collection is unavailable or incomplete. Check its availability and try verification again.

sourceIssue.invalid_source: Check the source address or account ID.
sourceIssue.session_unavailable: Telegram collection is waiting for an available authorized session.
sourceIssue.group_unavailable: Telegram source is unavailable or access is restricted.
sourceIssue.identity_changed: Source identity changed. Remove it and add the correct source again.
sourceIssue.rate_limited: Platform rate limit reached; collection will retry later.
sourceIssue.flood_wait: Telegram requested a delay; collection will retry later.
sourceIssue.busy: The shared integration is busy; collection will retry later.
sourceIssue.cooldown: Integration is cooling down after requests; collection will retry later.
sourceIssue.pagination_stalled: The source repeated a page. Coverage is incomplete.
sourceIssue.collection_limit: Collection window limit reached. Coverage is incomplete.
sourceIssue.page_item_limit: The source page exceeded the collection limit.
sourceIssue.unknown_publication_date: Some publication dates are unknown; coverage is incomplete.
sourceIssue.video_date_unavailable: The source omitted a video publication date.
sourceIssue.publication_url_unavailable: Some publications have no usable original link.
sourceIssue.item_quota: Daily collection quota reached; collection will continue later.
sourceIssue.configuration_gap: Changed filters or sources created a new collection coverage boundary.
sourceIssue.pause_gap: Collection was paused during this interval.
sourceIssue.federation_visibility_limited: Federated visibility depends on the Mastodon instance configured for this service.
sourceIssue.private_or_deleted_videos: Private or deleted videos could not be collected.
sourceIssue.news_pagination_repeated: News search returned the same results on another page; coverage is incomplete.
sourceIssue.invalid_news_domain: Use a public domain name in site:; IP addresses and internal domains are not accepted.
sourceIssue.collection_failed: Collection failed and will retry within its retry limit.

unknownDates: Materials without a known publication date: {count}.
truncated: The material limit was reached. This report contains a partial selection.
comparison: Change in saved publications against the previous comparable period: {difference}.

fileStatus.pending: Files are being prepared in the background
fileStatus.working: Files are being prepared in the background

settingsHint: Collection and delivery are separate. Changes affect future collection and reports; saved versions remain unchanged.
error: Could not complete request. Try again.
pausedHint: Collection and scheduled reports are stopped. Earlier reports remain available; a pause creates a coverage gap.
botNotLinked: Telegram bot is not linked. Reports remain available on the website.
noSources: Add a source. A background job will check its identity and availability.
deleteWarning: This permanently deletes project data and reports. Type “{name}” to confirm. Archive to keep history.
noReports: No reports yet. Add sources, allow collection to run and generate a report.
expired: Retention period ended. Report files and materials are no longer available.
backgroundHint: The report is built in the background. You can leave this page.
partialHint: Coverage is incomplete. Review source warnings before using this report.
emptyHint: No matching materials. Check coverage: insufficient history does not prove nothing was published.
failedHint: Generation failed. Request a new version and review source status.
lexicalHint: These are recurring words in publication text. This simple text heuristic can group unrelated mentions; review the cited originals.

sourceHint.news: site:example.org climate or a news search query

sourceInfo.telegram: Public channels and accessible public supergroups identified by username or their https://t.me/ address. Collection requires an available authorized Telegram session. Private invites and numeric source IDs are not accepted; an optional author filter uses a numeric Telegram user ID.
sourceInfo.youtube: New public videos from one channel, identified by channel ID, @handle or channel URL. The report uses titles, descriptions, publication dates and available metrics. Video URLs, comment parsing, audio and transcripts are not supported in monitoring.
sourceInfo.bluesky: Original public posts and replies from an exact handle, DID or https://bsky.app/profile/ address. The account is resolved to a permanent DID; reposts are excluded.
sourceInfo.mastodon: Public original posts visible to the Mastodon instance configured for this service. Enter a local username, federated account or HTTPS profile URL; the account must be visible to that configured instance. Boosts and non-public posts are excluded; federation may limit coverage.
sourceInfo.news: Enter a news search query, optionally restricted with site:example.org. The configured news search service returns titles, excerpts and original links; dates and historical coverage may be incomplete. Full articles and RSS/Atom feeds are not supported.

schedule.three_days: Every three calendar days from {anchor} at {time} ({timezone}); previous three complete days.
schedule.month: First day each month at {time} ({timezone}); previous calendar month.
